note: 流水线只定义『环节与候选工具』，不放任何数字——所有额度与换算一律从 data/*-quotas.json 读取（PRD-video-pipeline 第六节的硬规矩）。这样做的理由：数字在这里重抄一遍，就等于绕开了 quota-facts 门禁的检查范围。

video.claim_zh: 一条全免费短视频流水线的月产能，不取决于最强的那个工具，取决于最稀缺的那一环。
video.claim_en: The monthly output of an all-free short-video pipeline is not set by the best tool in it — it is set by the scarcest link.

stages.role_zh: 把选题写成分镜脚本。这一环几乎不设量的墙——对话类十家里绝大多数根本不公布条数上限，墙在别处（上下文长度、滚动窗口）。所以它基本不会是你的瓶颈。
stages.role_en: Turn the idea into a shot-by-shot script. This link is almost never metered by volume — most of the ten chat vendors publish no message cap at all, and their walls sit elsewhere (context length, rolling windows). It will rarely be your bottleneck.

stages.role_zh: 先出静帧再去图生视频，比直接文生视频稳得多——而且静帧这一环额度最松，是整条链路里最不该省的地方。
stages.role_en: Generate stills first and animate them, rather than going straight from text to video: it is far more controllable, and this is the loosest link in the chain, so it is the last place worth economising.

stages.role_zh: 把静帧变成会动的片段。这一环是全行业最不让你算的一环——多数厂商只给积分不给换算，或只给换算不给总量。
stages.role_en: Turn stills into moving clips. This is the link the industry is least willing to let you compute: most vendors give credits without a conversion rate, or a rate without a total.

stages.role_zh: 配音额度按分钟或字符发放，算起来最干脆。也正因为算得出来，它常常才是真正卡住整条线的那一环——这跟「瓶颈一定在生视频」的直觉相反。
stages.role_en: Voice allowances come in minutes or characters, which makes this the easiest link to compute — and precisely because it can be computed, it often turns out to be the one that actually caps the line, against the intuition that video generation must be the bottleneck.

stages.role_zh: 自动剪辑与加字幕。这一环按「处理时长」计费，跟你出多少条无关，跟你的片子多长有关。
stages.role_en: Automatic cutting and captioning. This link is metered by minutes of footage processed, so it scales with how long your videos are, not how many you make.

stages.role_zh: 背景音乐。可选环——用免费素材库也行；但要注意 Suno 免费档不可商用，这条墙比额度硬。
stages.role_en: Background music. Optional — a free stock library also works. Note that Suno's free tier is not licensed for commercial use, a wall harder than any quota.
